title: Ops quick bucketization and ask roster — May 2026
body:
Purpose:
Quick, lightweight bucketization of outstanding cross-functional asks related to short-term coverage and runtime capacity for the coming two weeks. This is not the canonical backlog — it's a temporary roster to help on-call and ops leads prioritize manual cover tasks and owner handoffs during the surge window (May 16–29).

Context / how to use:
- Single-page working doc for rapid triage in daily 9:30 stand.
- Buckets are intentionally coarse: Triage, Recovery, Hand-off, Low-effort Ops, and Monitoring Tuning.
- Each row is an ask that we expect to resolve or reclass during the week.
- Owners should update the "Notes" cell when they take action; try to close or escalate within 48 hours.

Summary counts (snapshot 2026-05-14):
- Triage: 6
- Recovery (hotfixes / routing fallback): 4
- Hand-off (requires SME for rollout): 5
- Low-effort Ops (<=2 engineer-days): 7
- Monitoring Tuning (dash/alert tweaks): 3

Mini roster table (columns separated by | for quick paste into Slack):
Owner | Short ask | Bucket | Priority | ETA | Notes
Aisha Rahman | Add regional fallback for EU-ndx route | Recovery | P0 | 2026-05-16 | Waiting on infra IP allowlist; jira INFR-4321
Jon Park | Lightweight sampling for latency tails on config-service | Monitoring Tuning | P2 | 2026-05-20 | Dashboard patch drafted, needs review (PR #678)
Sofia Martinez | Hand-off: dedicated pool handoff doc for SE pilot | Hand-off | P1 | 2026-05-21 | Draft in docs; needs SE signoff
Ravi Gupta | Triage: endpoint throttle rule causing 429s for internal-be | Triage | P0 | 2026-05-15 | Temporary revert applied; root cause investigation ongoing
Ellen Cho | Low-effort Ops: rotate key for demo infra account | Low-effort Ops | P3 | 2026-05-18 | Security notified, schedule rotation window
Marcus Reed | Recovery: rewire fallback to model-variant-b when region full | Recovery | P1 | 2026-05-17 | Simulated in staging, awaiting canary window

Notes / observations:
- Several asks are cross-team handoffs that require explicit SMR (subject matter relay) - product-ops + infra + se. Recommend an "owner-of-record" tag in future passes.
- There's a recurring pattern: short-term recoveries spike after model catalog refreshes. Consider automated quick-rollback policy for catalog pushes with <24h ramp.
- Sampled latency evening tail on config-service seems correlated with small BFF cache misses; Jon to run longer sampling and share histogram by 5/20.

Risk flags / escalation guidance:
- Any Recovery bucket that touches routing or key management -> escalate to on-call infra lead immediately (pager + Slack channel #infra-pager).
- Hand-offs with >3 downstream owners should be converted to tracked rollout plan and moved to product-ops backlog.

Open questions / to resolve this week:
- Do we have permission to apply EU allowlist changes for fallback infra, or does that require security approval? (Aisha action)
- Which SE(s) can pair for the dedicated-pool handoff pilot next Wed? (Sofia to confirm)
- Can we automate a one-click rollback for model catalog items in the console? (depends on platform road map — link to PL ticket: https://linear.app/PL/issue/PL-1123)

Immediate action items (owners):
- Aisha: follow up on IP allowlist gating (due 5/16). Update row and escalate if blocked more than 12 hours.
- Ravi: post RCA stub in thread and attach repro steps (due 5/15).
- Jon: finish histogram sampling and attach graphs to doc (due 5/20).
- Sofia: get SE list and book 1-hour handoff slot (due 5/17).

Quick capacity estimate (very rough):
- Total open asks ~25 work-units; estimated engineer-days = 10–14 (mostly small).
- Expect two P0 recoveries that require immediate 4–6 hour hotfix windows.

Links & references:
- Current on-call infra rota: https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/infra-may-2026
- Quick revert playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/quick-revert-playbook
- Related Linear: INFR-4321, INFR-4350, PL-1123

Audit trail / edits log (short):
2026-05-12 Aisha created initial roster and bucket defs.
2026-05-13 Ravi added Triage rows after incident postmortem.
2026-05-14 Jon added monitoring sampling item + linked PR.

Remember: this is a transient, tactical roster — don't bury CNBD material here. If an ask grows beyond 3 owners or >3 days to close, move it into the formal backlog with a ticket and rollout owner.
